description: Machine-readable map of API route groups, services, lib modules, and their interactions. Paths are relative to server/.

auth.notes: Validates Bearer JWT (15m access token), attaches { userId, role } to the request. Refresh-token rotation/revocation in lib/auth/session.ts. 2FA challenge tokens (5m) for accounts with email-code 2FA.

endpoints.POST /login: Password check; 2FA accounts get challenge token; returns access+refresh tokens
endpoints.POST /logout-all: Revoke every session for the user
endpoints.POST /delete-account: Permanently delete account (free identity for re-register)

endpoints.POST /posts/[id]/like|bookmark|hide|repo: Post actions; like/view return authoritative counts
endpoints.POST /videos/[id]/like|view: Video actions; views are deduped per account (post_views)

endpoints.GET /albums/[id]: Album detail; locked item URLs nulled; isUnlockedByMe from live rows
endpoints.POST /albums/[id]/unlock: Atomic purchase: wallet debit + creator credit + transactions + album_unlocks; 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE on low balance; { purchased, already_unlocked }

endpoints.POST /payments/initiate-paystack: Create Paystack virtual account (config-gated 503 without keys)

endpoints.GET/POST /chat-rooms: List/create rooms (idempotent; strictly scoped to authenticated user)

endpoints.GET /notifications: Notification feed (likes, comments, subscriptions, messages, new posts)

endpoints.POST /uploads: Authorize direct-to-R2 upload → upload_sessions + presigned URLs
endpoints.POST /uploads/[id]/complete: Verify bytes in R2, create media row

endpoints.credentials/*: Credential broker endpoints (token grant/refresh/revoke, config, db, email, payment, upload-url, download-url)

services.lib/services/albums.ts: Album load/access rules: owner/purchaser/locked; nulls item URLs when locked; unlock transaction
services.lib/services/chat-rooms.ts: Chat room + message CRUD, scoped to authenticated user; changes polling
services.lib/services/comment-rooms.ts: Comment room CRUD, comments, likes, replies; changes polling
services.lib/services/content.ts: Posts/shorts/videos/albums content model, feed queries, share token mint+resolve
services.lib/services/email.ts: Resend transactional email; MeetSweet branding; 5 templates with silhouette SVG
services.lib/services/pricing.ts: Authoritative creator pricing (resolveBasePrice, default ₦200, album price aliases)
services.lib/services/r2.ts: S3-compatible R2 client, presigning, immutable CacheControl
services.lib/services/stream.ts: Cloudflare Stream HLS multi-quality (optional; MP4 fallback)
services.lib/services/uploads.ts: Direct-to-R2 upload sessions: presign, multipart orchestration, complete

lib_modules.lib/auth/jwt.ts: jose HS256: access 15m, refresh 30d (unique jti), 2FA challenge 5m
lib_modules.lib/config.ts: Env config with production-name fallbacks; serviceConfigured() gates

key_interactions.auth_flow: register → verify-email (code) → auto-login; login → (2FA challenge → 2fa/verify) → access+refresh tokens; refresh rotates; logout revokes; expired/revoked refresh → 401 → client forces re-login
key_interactions.upload_flow: POST /uploads → presigned R2 PUT (or parts) → POST /uploads/:id/complete → media row → attach to post/album/short
key_interactions.album_purchase_flow: GET /albums/:id (locked) → POST /albums/:id/unlock (atomic debit+credit+unlocks) → GET /albums/:id now unlocked; client wallet + header balance update from server response
key_interactions.wallet_flow: POST /payments/initiate-paystack (virtual account) → paystack-webhook confirms → transactions row + wallet credit → client polls/refetches balance
key_interactions.share_flow: POST /share/create → token → client opens meetsweet://s/<token> → POST /share/resolve/:token → deep-link to post/album/creator screen
key_interactions.realtime_flow: Mutations (like/comment/subscribe/unlock) return authoritative state in the response; chat/comment rooms expose /changes polling endpoints
